T: Pick a side. Pick a plate.
D: A new set of rules for superheroes splits the Avengers into two camps.
P: Serve dessert when Tony sits in Aunt May's kitchen with her walnut date loaf.
S: Peanut and chili spiced beef skewers grilled until charred, with onion and tomato
Beef strips rubbed with ground peanuts, paprika, ginger and chilli, threaded onto skewers and grilled, with sliced onion and tomato.
Sliced grilled bratwurst in curry tomato sauce, with crisp baked fries
Bratwurst grilled until browned and sliced into rounds, smothered in a warm sauce of tomato, curry powder and smoked paprika, with a pile of hot fries.

Flaky puff pastry squares folded around sweet lemon cream cheese, baked golden, glazed with apricot jam and dusted with icing sugar. Beat 250g cream cheese with 60g caster sugar, 1 egg yolk, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 tsp vanilla. Cut 2 thawed puff pastry sheets into 9 squares each. Spoon filling into the middle and fold two opposite corners over to meet. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Brush with 3 tbsp warmed apricot jam, cool a little and dust with icing sugar.
M: Beef goulash with sweet paprika over buttered egg noodles, sour cream on top
Beef chuck browned with onions and lots of paprika, simmered 3 hours with tomato until thick, with buttered noodles and sour cream.
Tony visiting Peter at Aunt May's

Pork and beef meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered in a slow garlic tomato sauce, over spaghetti with more parmesan. Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g grated parmesan, 1 egg, chopped parsley and salt, and roll into 20 balls. Brown in olive oil and set aside. Soften 3 garlic cloves and 1 diced onion, add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and basil, and simmer 20 minutes. Add the meatballs and simmer 20 minutes more. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and top with meatballs and parmesan.
W: Moist walnut date loaf baked with brown sugar
Dates soaked in hot water and bicarb, mixed with butter, brown sugar, egg, flour and walnuts, baked in a loaf tin at 175C for 50 minutes, sliced and buttered.
K: Team Cap and Team Iron Man fizz
Raspberry cranberry soda in red, butterfly pea lemonade in blue, no alcohol

Pick a side: a red cranberry, raspberry and lime fizz or a blue butterfly pea lemonade, served side by side over ice. Team Iron Man: muddle 125g raspberries with 2 tbsp sugar, add 400ml cranberry juice and the juice of 1 lime, strain and top 2 glasses of ice with it and soda water. Team Cap: steep 1 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 250ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain, chill and pour into 2 glasses of ice, then top with lemonade. Line them up and let everyone choose.

dishes.make_ahead: Spice mix up to 1 week, store airtight

ingredients.item: beef rump, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Mix the ground peanuts with the paprika, ginger, chilli flakes and salt.
Thread the beef onto soaked skewers and coat all over in the spice.
Grill on high heat until charred.
Serve with sliced onion and tomato, sprinkled with more spice.

ingredients.item: curry powder, plus extra for dusting

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss in oil and spread on trays.
Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Grill the bratwurst until browned, then slice into rounds.
Warm the tomato sauce with the curry powder and paprika.
Pour over the sausage, dust with curry powder and serve with the fries.
Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.
Add the onions and paprika and stir until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and enough water to cover.
Cover and simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the beef is very tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the noodles and toss with butter.
Serve the goulash over the noodles with sour cream.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions and paprika and stir until soft and fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and stock and return the mushrooms.
Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick.
Cook the noodles and toss with the butter.
Serve the goulash over the noodles with the sour cream.
Pour the boiling water over the dates and bicarb soda and leave to soften.
Beat in the butter, sugar and egg, then fold in the flour and walnuts.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175C until a skewer comes out clean.
Slice and serve buttered.

s.note: Peanut and chili spiced beef skewers grilled until charred, with onion and tomato
s.how: Mix 100g finely ground peanuts with smoked paprika, ground ginger, chilli flakes and salt. Thread 600g thin rump strips onto skewers, coat in the spice and grill until charred. Serve with sliced red onion and tomato, sprinkled with more spice.

s.note: Sliced grilled bratwurst in curry tomato sauce, with crisp baked fries
s.how: Cut 800g potatoes into fries and bake until crisp. Grill 4 bratwurst until browned and slice into rounds. Warm 200ml tomato sauce with 2 tsp curry powder and a pinch of smoked paprika. Pour over the sausage and dust with more curry powder. Serve with the fries.

m.note: Beef goulash with sweet paprika over buttered egg noodles, sour cream on top
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 sliced onions and 3 tbsp sweet paprika. Add a can of crushed tomatoes and water to cover and simmer for 3 hours until thick. Serve over buttered egg noodles with a spoon of sour cream.

w.note: Moist walnut date loaf baked with brown sugar
w.how: Pour 250ml boiling water over 200g chopped dates and a teaspoon of bicarb soda and leave 10 minutes. Beat in 60g butter, 150g brown sugar and an egg, then fold in 250g self-raising flour and 80g walnuts. Bake at 175C for 50 minutes. Slice and butter.

Team Cap: steep 1 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 250ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain, chill and pour into 2 glasses of ice, then top with lemonade. Line them up and let everyone choose.
